requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The BS requires at least 120 credits, with 60 of the 120 earned in residence and 30 of the final 60 in residence. A cumulative GPA of 2.0 is required to graduate. Kinesiology courses and courses required for the degree may not be taken pass fail; at most four pass fail courses outside Kinesiology are allowed, no more than one per term. Requirements follow the 2025-2026 Undergraduate Bulletin.

requirements.label: Humanities distribution (12 credits)
requirements.hint: Twelve credits of humanities coursework. Major courses may double count; the record sheet pre-populates MOVESCI 219 here, and all U-M language courses count as humanities for Kinesiology students. Kinesiology courses do not carry LSA distribution marks in the planner, so add them to this requirement with the include control when you use them for distribution.

requirements.label: Natural Science distribution (12 credits)
requirements.hint: Twelve credits of natural science coursework. Major courses double count; the record sheet pre-populates MATH 115, CHEM 130, BIOLOGY 171 and 172, PHYSIOL 201, and ANATOMY 403, which already exceed the minimum.

requirements.label: Social Science distribution (12 credits)
requirements.hint: Twelve credits of social science coursework. Major courses may double count; the record sheet pre-populates PSYCH 111. Kinesiology courses do not carry LSA distribution marks in the planner, so add them with the include control when you use them for distribution.

requirements.label: First year writing
requirements.hint: ENGLISH 125 or another approved first year writing course, with a grade of C or better.

requirements.label: BIOLOGY 171 and 173
requirements.hint: BIOLOGY 171 Introductory Biology: Ecology and Evolution, plus the BIOLOGY 173 lab. AP credit (BIOLOGY 195) will not fulfill the lab. External transfer students can cover the lecture sequence with BIOLOGY 191 and 192; add such substitutions with the include control.

requirements.label: BIOLOGY 172 or 174
requirements.hint: Introductory cellular and molecular biology; elect either BIOLOGY 172 or BIOLOGY 174, not both. Prior or concurrent enrollment in CHEM 130 is advised.

requirements.label: General chemistry
requirements.hint: CHEM 130. For students who do not take CHEM 130, successful completion of CHEM 210 fulfills the requirement.

requirements.label: Calculus I
requirements.hint: MATH 115. AP credit for MATH 120 also fulfills this requirement.

requirements.label: ANATOMY 403
requirements.hint: Human Anatomy: Structure and Function, 5 credits, from the Medical School.

requirements.label: Introductory physics
requirements.hint: PHYSICS 140 or PHYSICS 150 with a C- or better. PHYSICS 125 transfer credit for algebra based Physics I also fulfills this requirement.

requirements.label: PHYSIOL 201
requirements.hint: Introduction to Human Physiology. Prior completion of BIOLOGY 172 or 174 is strongly recommended.

requirements.label: Introductory psychology
requirements.hint: PSYCH 111 or PSYCH 112; elect one, not both.

requirements.label: MOVESCI 110 and 219
requirements.hint: MOVESCI 110 Biological and Behavioral Bases of Human Movement and MOVESCI 219 Scientific Writing, the Kinesiology prerequisites for the 300 level core.

requirements.label: MOVESCI 230 and 231
requirements.hint: Human Musculoskeletal Anatomy lecture and lab, taken concurrently. Non Kinesiology students attempting to transfer may take them non concurrently.

requirements.label: Statistics (MOVESCI 250)
requirements.hint: MOVESCI 250 Statistics and Research Methods in Movement Science. Effective Fall 2025 this can be substituted with STATS 250; STATS 250 taken before transferring to Kinesiology also fulfills it.

requirements.label: MOVESCI 320, 330, and 340
requirements.hint: Motor Control, Biomechanics of Human Movement, and Exercise Physiology, the 4 credit core. All three must be taken at the University of Michigan, and all enforced prerequisites must be completed first with no concurrent enrollment.

requirements.label: Upper level MOVESCI electives (9 credits)
requirements.hint: Nine credits of upper division Movement Science electives from the published lecture based list, with at least six credits lecture based. Up to three credits of 400 level experiential or independent study work, for example MOVESCI 429, 439, 449, or 464, may substitute for one lecture course; add such a course with the include control.

requirements.label: Cognate electives (11 credits)
requirements.hint: Eleven credits of cognate electives outside Movement Science, with at least six of the eleven outside the School of Kinesiology. Matched against the published November 2022 cognate list; the department can approve other courses by petition, so add approved off list courses with the include control. Women's Studies courses on the list now run under the WGS subject.
